下面的幹葉圖顯示一群文娛中心的會員的年歲的分佈。

$$\begin{array}{r|l}
\text{幹 (十位)} & \text{葉 (個位)} \\
\hline
5 & 0 \quad 5 \quad 6 \quad 6 \quad 8 \\
6 & 1 \quad 4 \quad 5 \quad 5 \quad 7 \quad 8 \quad 8 \quad 9 \\
7 & 3 \quad 4 \quad 4 \quad 6 \quad 7 \quad 9 \\
8 & \\
9 & 1
\end{array}$$

從該群中隨機選出一名會員。求所選出的會員的年歲不小於 74 的概率。

A. 0.2
B. 0.3
C. 0.7
D. 0.8
reasoning: The stem‑and‑leaf plot gives the ages: 50,55,56,56,58 (5 members), 61,64,65,65,67,68,68,69 (8 members), 73,74,74,76,77,79 (6 members), none in the 80s, and 91 (1 member). Total members = 5+8+6+1 = 20. Ages ≥ 74 are: 74,74,76,77,79,91 → 6 members. Probability = 6/20 = 0.3, which corresponds to option B.
